card.text: The Southern Ring Nebula's central star is a hot white dwarf, about 754 parsecs away.

sources.label: Marco et al. (2023), Nature Astronomy, 2022, Vol. 6, p. 1421
sources.locator: Results: a central star of effective temperature 110 kK and luminosity 200 Lsun matches the observations; the A2 V companion is 1.7 arcsec away

introduction.text: A model of the nebula's light needs a star of 110,000 K with 200 times the Sun's light. The bright star beside it is its companion.
